name: keyleaks
description: One-command local audit for credential-like values in coding-agent chat histories.

scripts.test: node --check bin/chat-secret-audit.js && node --check bin/postinstall.js && node --check lib/native-audit.js && node --check test-detectors.js && node test-detectors.js && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js --json >/tmp/keyleaks-test.json && python3 -m json.tool /tmp/keyleaks-test.json >/dev/null && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js details >/tmp/keyleaks-details.txt && grep -q 'Coding Agent' /tmp/keyleaks-details.txt && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js types >/tmp/keyleaks-types.txt && grep -q 'Key Type' /tmp/keyleaks-types.txt && grep -q 'Assistant' /tmp/keyleaks-types.txt && rm -f /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.json /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.txt && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js types --show-values --agent pi --output /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.json >/tmp/keyleaks-show-values.txt && grep -q '^Open file:[[:space:]]*file://' /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.txt && python3 -m json.tool /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.json >/dev/null && test $(stat -f %Lp /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.json 2>/dev/null || stat -c %a /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.json) = 600 && ! node bin/chat-secret-audit.js --show-values >/tmp/keyleaks-invalid-show-values.txt 2>&1 && grep -q 'only supported' /tmp/keyleaks-invalid-show-values.txt && rm -f /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.json /tmp/keyleaks-show-values.txt /tmp/keyleaks-invalid-show-values.txt && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js --agent codex >/tmp/keyleaks-codex.txt && grep -q '^Codex[[:space:]]' /tmp/keyleaks-codex.txt
